title: 時間敏感網路
summary: 以排程閘門、時間同步與可界定延遲串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect scheduled gates, synchronization and bounded latency through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 流量需求合約：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Traffic contracts: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「流量需求合約」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For traffic contracts, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「流量需求合約」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：到達率、突發量與截止時間一起限定可接受負載。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：只改閘門開啟時間，觀察臨界流量等待。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「時間基準」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around traffic contracts, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Rate, bursts and deadlines jointly define admissible traffic. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Change gate-open time only and observe critical-flow waiting. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat time reference as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 只改閘門開啟時間，觀察臨界流量等待。 比較「流量需求合約」與「時間基準」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Change gate-open time only and observe critical-flow waiting. Compare whether evidence for traffic contracts and time reference supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 優先權高便保證任何負載下零延遲。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: High priority guarantees zero delay at every load. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「流量需求合約」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for traffic contracts. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 到達率、突發量與截止時間一起限定可接受負載。
knowledge.textEn: Rate, bursts and deadlines jointly define admissible traffic.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「時間基準」：跨橋排程需要共享時基及有限同步誤差。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「流量需求合約」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring time reference: Cross-bridge schedules need a shared timebase and bounded synchronization error. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove traffic contracts passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 只改閘門開啟時間，觀察臨界流量等待。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Change gate-open time only and observe critical-flow waiting. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假設 1 Gbit/s 上傳送 1500 byte 訊框，純內容序列化為 12 μs；1 ms 週期留 100 μs，忽略 overhead 可容納 8 框，實際須再扣 guard band 與開銷。
knowledge.textEn: At 1 Gbit/s, 1500-byte payload serialization is 12 μs; a 100 μs window in a 1 ms cycle fits at most eight such payloads before overhead and guard bands.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「時間敏感網路」的「流量需求合約：架構與原理」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出輸入資料、處理狀態、傳輸與輸出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「可信服務：中斷後的交班」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與輸入版本、時間追蹤、資源計數與可重播的小型測試的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Traffic contracts: architecture and principle” in “Time-sensitive networking”. Draw the input, processing state, transport and output boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Trusted Service: Handoff After an Outage” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for input version, time traces, resource counters and a replayable small test, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 針對「流量需求合約」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of traffic contracts?
options: 到達率、突發量與截止時間一起限定可接受負載。
優先權高便保證任何負載下零延遲。
只檢查「時間基準」，便可取代「流量需求合約」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Rate, bursts and deadlines jointly define admissible traffic.
High priority guarantees zero delay at every load.
Checking time reference alone replaces verification specific to traffic contracts.
quiz.explanation: 到達率、突發量與截止時間一起限定可接受負載。 相鄰的「時間基準」有不同責任：跨橋排程需要共享時基及有限同步誤差。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Rate, bursts and deadlines jointly define admissible traffic. Neighboring time reference has a different role: Cross-bridge schedules need a shared timebase and bounded synchronization error. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 流量需求合約：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Traffic contracts: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「流量需求合約」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For traffic contracts, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「到達率、突發量與截止時間一起限定可接受負載。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：只改閘門開啟時間，觀察臨界流量等待。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「時間基準」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Rate, bursts and deadlines jointly define admissible traffic. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Change gate-open time only and observe critical-flow waiting. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from time reference to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 只改閘門開啟時間，觀察臨界流量等待。 比較「流量需求合約」與「時間基準」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Change gate-open time only and observe critical-flow waiting. Compare whether evidence for traffic contracts and time reference supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 優先權高便保證任何負載下零延遲。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: High priority guarantees zero delay at every load. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「流量需求合約」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for traffic contracts. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「訊框序列化」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：序列化時間與位元數成正比、與鏈路速率成反比。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：只改閘門開啟時間，觀察臨界流量等待。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「佇列映射」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around frame serialization, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Serialization time scales with bits and inversely with link rate. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Change gate-open time only and observe critical-flow waiting. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat queue mapping as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 只改閘門開啟時間，觀察臨界流量等待。 比較「訊框序列化」與「佇列映射」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Change gate-open time only and observe critical-flow waiting. Compare whether evidence for frame serialization and queue mapping supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 優先權高便保證任何負載下零延遲。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: High priority guarantees zero delay at every load. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「訊框序列化」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for frame serialization. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 序列化時間與位元數成正比、與鏈路速率成反比。

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「佇列映射」：分類將流映射至佇列；分類錯誤會破壞排程假設。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「訊框序列化」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring queue mapping: Classification maps streams to queues; mistakes break scheduling assumptions. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove frame serialization passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 只改閘門開啟時間，觀察臨界流量等待。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Change gate-open time only and observe critical-flow waiting. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

quiz.question: 針對「訊框序列化」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of frame serialization?
options: 優先權高便保證任何負載下零延遲。
只檢查「佇列映射」，便可取代「訊框序列化」的專屬驗證。
序列化時間與位元數成正比、與鏈路速率成反比。
optionsEn: High priority guarantees zero delay at every load.
Checking queue mapping alone replaces verification specific to frame serialization.
Serialization time scales with bits and inversely with link rate.
quiz.explanation: 序列化時間與位元數成正比、與鏈路速率成反比。 相鄰的「佇列映射」有不同責任：分類將流映射至佇列；分類錯誤會破壞排程假設。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
